"""Turn a title into a short slug."""

import re


def slugify(title):
    s = title.lower()
    s = s.replace("&", " and ")
    s = "".join(
        ch for ch in s
        if ("a" <= ch <= "z") or ("0" <= ch <= "9") or ch in " -"
    )
    s = re.sub(r"[ -]+", "-", s)
    s = s.strip("-")
    if len(s) > 40:
        s = s[:40].rstrip("-")
    return s
